title: ORM Repository Module Compiler
description: Compiles a typed ORM repository from a data access spec. Enforces: no HTTP framework imports, fully typed signatures (no any), paginated reads require stable ordering, mutating methods return typed results, no raw SQL unless explicitly escaped, no external network calls.

error_codes.OR002: Repository entity not found in migration-artifact — compile db-migration first
error_codes.OR005: Repository imports HTTP framework types (express, fastify, Request, Response)
error_codes.OR006: Repository makes external network call (fetch, axios, http.request)
error_codes.OR007: Paginated repository method lacks stable ordering (ORDER BY required)
error_codes.OR008: Mutating method has no typed return (void or undefined not allowed for writes)
error_codes.OR009: Raw SQL without explicit escape hatch comment
